name: Joi/Minako
source:
Noma Minako is a surgeon who gets fired from the clinic due to amoral behavior. Now she gets a job in another clinic. Minako has both masculine and feminine personality in her, but only one side is determined to dominate depending on choices.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
野间美奈子是一名外科医生，因不道德行为被诊所解雇。如今，她在另一家诊所找到了工作。美奈子体内同时存在男性化与女性化的两种人格，玩家的选择将决定其中哪一面占据主导。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
